definition: Mean VR-derived pedestrian speed is below 0.15 m/s or the segment contains near-zero speed.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: VR-derived speed stays below 0.10 m/s for at least 0.12 seconds.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Speed shows a short measured dip: drop >0.18 m/s and >22%, with partial recovery within 1.5 seconds.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Pedestrian speed slope is positive enough to indicate rising speed.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Pedestrian speed slope is negative enough to indicate falling speed.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Speed coefficient of variation is low while mean speed is above walking threshold.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Speed coefficient of variation is elevated without a clear increasing/decreasing slope.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Motion does not cleanly match the other measured motion tags.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Head turn spike is brief and exceeds 120 deg/s.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Head turn rate or head/body yaw difference is elevated.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Head turn activity stays below the head_checking/head_active thresholds.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Near-car context with measured slowing, pausing, or hesitation.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Near-car context with measured steady or increasing movement.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Near-car context with fluctuating motion or a high-jerk hesitation.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.

definition: Car-pedestrian distance never drops below the near-car threshold.
labeling_note: Descriptive measured tag. Motion, head, and car-context tags are intentionally not pre-fused.
